about: Modwerk source-only improved-fltr package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/improved-fltr.

mods.title: Improved FLTR
mods.summary: A base-width type on the FILTER page: the Rytm's analog filter as a high-pass and a low-pass in one, FRQ setting the base and a WID knob the width above it.
mods.description: FILTER TYP turns past PK to BW. In BW the voice's own analog 2-pole filter runs as a band: FRQ sets the high-pass edge, and RES's knob, which reads WID, sets how far above it the low-pass edge sits, from one semitone to five octaves, shown in hertz. FRQ, an LFO on it and the filter envelope move the whole band; an LFO or lock on WID changes its width. The FILTER graph draws the band as measured. All analog; wider bands are quieter, so set VOL by ear.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, by the author's automated USB test rig on 23 November 2026, from RAM in the author's combined test images with a development base and a USB test link: the analog words BW sends and TYP's stop at BW as computed (IFD2, IFC5), and the band's edges measured with noise (IFC5): top edges within about 3 % of WID, bottom edges 2 to 18 % above FRQ. This package has not been flashed from the site.
